## Evidence And Definitions
Frozen inputs were 863 visible training records, 35 KB claims and 11,215 lab candidates. Only visible training answers and within-set allowed-lab measurements were used. Refresh at the research checkpoint repinned Jbb8de54d2489_research_e0001, with no new history records. Other projects' new experiments were not incorporated.
Nominal displacement D is a proxy, not a measured parameter norm: adaptive optimizers use lr*T; Adagrad uses 2*lr*sqrt(T); SGD uses lr*T*g/(1-m), with assumed g=.01, bigram .003, momentum-MSE .03. Progress means improved held-out loss relative to insufficiently learned rivals; late precision means a smaller rate beats a larger rate at the SAME budget, not simply that longer training worsens loss.
Training gold answers supply ordinal outcomes only. Lab values are ten-seed mean and seed SD, not confidence intervals. A win is a lower mean; multiple pairs sharing candidates/seeds are dependent.
